text: {"action": null, "answer": "Project Zenith is a new initiative aimed at revolutionizing data analytics, with a kick-off scheduled for June 15th and an initial budget of $500,000 for phase one, led by Sarah Tan. The project has since secured a $2M budget approval from the executive board to cover research, development, and marketing phases. Significant progress has been made, including a breakthrough in predictive analytics during phase two and the successful completion of the testing phase. Strategic partnerships have been established, notably with TechInnovate, an AI research leader. The team has expanded with new members specializing in cybersecurity, cloud architecture, machine learning, and cloud computing. Feedback is currently being sought on the prototype's performance and user experience, with a detailed report on phase two progress to be shared in a staff meeting on November 20th."}
